articles.expand: 6A (Australian dollar futures) is sitting at the middle of a consolidation range that has held since Feb, at 0.704 as of Oct 30, where yearly VWAP and CVPOC meet. Hotter Australian inflation has lifted the odds of an RBA hike on Nov 3, while a split Fed, volatile oil and weak Chinese iron ore keep the pressure two-sided. Key levels are 0.704 (Mid range) and 0.69 (Daily level 2). Possible outcomes over the next few weeks include a push toward 0.72 (Daily level 1), a rotation lower toward 0.69, or a downside break toward 0.673 (Daily level 3).

As it would seem, getting to the finish line and convincing policymakers to do something about it are two very different things.
